items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: I didn’t even know how to pronounce Sidney Bechet’s last name at that point. I just knew the music was good.

ctx.x: I think the economic truism that supply and demand certainly applies to rare recordings and so forth. Do you have a memory of searching through bins and Salvation Army stuff, what has been some of the significant finds that you may recall?

I’ve been very fortunate in that respect over the years and have found many good records like that too. You know because like it occurred to me when I was young that I was only going to find the music I liked or the records I liked by going through used record bins because they weren’t for sale at retailers any longer. I was about twenty years too late for the music that really captured my imagination. So I still remember the first important record I ever found I was about eleven or twelve years old and I was…
That’s a great story. Yeah, like oh who’s this, is this Sidney Bechet and what does he play?
